verdict.rationale: The MI325X is a datacenter GPU accelerator, so there is no product UI whose actions could be mirrored by an API; UI/API parity is a SaaS or application axis, not a hardware one. The evidence shows only programmatic and CLI tooling (ROCm libraries, AMD SMI, the Kubernetes GPU Operator, a metrics exporter) and no UI to compare against, so the wrong-axis exception does not apply.
